name: web-orange-glow-real-estate-listing-site-on-tilted-screen
title: Real-estate investment site on a tilted screen against a black-to-orange glow
whatItIs: A close, tilted view of a website on a dark orange-black gradient. Top pills say Website Design, Mobile Responsive and Development; the page has 'Explore Investment Opportunities' with a counter badge, filter chips and cards for houses with status tags.
whatItMeans: Bold and warm; the glow makes a clean white site feel dramatic.
techniques: Tilt the browser in perspective on a glowing gradient.
Add small outlined pills above as service tags.
Use a counter badge next to the headline.
Show listing cards with small status chips.

vocabulary.definition: Outlined pills listing what was delivered.
A dark background with a warm bloom.
A small label such as Rented on a card.
An angled view of a screen.
